outcome: Difference between pre/post operative haemoglobin level
cohort: 65 women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy out of 100,567 deliveries
finding: The majority of peripartum hysterectomies were due to placenta accreta spectrum disorders, and planned peripartum hysterectomies were associated with lower morbidity compared to emergency hysterectomies.
mod_finding: The majority of peripartum hysterectomy cases are due to placenta accreta spectrum disorders, and those that were planned had a lower morbidity rate compared to emergency hysterectomies.
birth_weight: Measured but no significant difference found between groups
